text: Nordwind renewal is up in September. Their account note says the bulk import experience is the single thing they'd churn over.
Consistent with what I see. Every ticket they file is import-related. They run one 4000-row import every Monday and it fails more often than it succeeds.
That makes the limiter rewrite a revenue item, not a tech-debt item. I'm going to argue for repriotising it above the driver app.
I'd support that if the blocker is schedulable. Last I heard it was waiting on infra work nobody had sized.
